title: Roost Ultimate: Oldschool
description: Combines the visuals of the new Roost Ultimate with the design of the old Roost Mod
body:
Original Idea and some assets from [MINT_Gaming_Studios](https://www.curseforge.com/minecraft/texture-packs/roost-ultimate-back-to-the-roost)

An attempt to combine the new functionality of Roost Ultimate and the visuals of Roost Mod with an emphasis on consistency, readability, and aesthetics.
